title: incident-bot: automated diagnostics + runbook linking for on-call alerts
author: Aisha Patel
description: Add automated diagnostics and runbook linking to incident-bot so on-call alerts include a concise diagnostics summary and direct runbook links. Motivation: reduce mean time to acknowledgement and resolution by surfacing relevant troubleshooting steps and recent SLO/metric context directly in pager messages and the alert Slack thread. Changes: (1) new diagnostics runner that collects top CPU/memory processes, recent scheduler errors, last 10 slow requests from observability API, and recent KV cache miss rates; (2) runbook registry integration that maps alert signatures (alert_rule_id and normalized summary) to runbook URLs and short action items; (3) UI/Slack formatter changes to include a one-line diagnostic summary, top-3 recommended runbook links, and a single-click acknowledgement + runbook open button; (4) small SLO toolkit utilities to expose evaluation snippets used by diagnostics; (5) tests and CI updates, including a lightweight fixture for offline runbook lookup. Checklist: - [x] implement diagnostics runner - [x] integrate runbook registry - [x] add Slack formatting and buttons - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] e2e smoke run on staging - [x] update docs and runbook registry CSV. Related: Linear ENG-4821, SRE-119. No breaking API changes to external consumers.

review_comments: Ben Carter: Nice work — the diagnostics runner looks comprehensive. Two nit requests: (1) can we limit the process list to top 5 by RSS and (2) add a metric tag so we can filter diagnostics runs in prometheus?
Aisha Patel: Addressed both nits — now limits to top-5 by RSS and emits diagnostics.run count with alert_rule_id tag. PTAL.
Maya Liu: One behavior question: if the runbook registry has multiple matches, do we show all links or pick top-3? I think top-3 is correct but please confirm tie-breaker semantics.
Aisha Patel: We return up to 3 links ordered by explicit mapping score then last_updated timestamp. Added a comment and test for tie-breaker.
Omar Singh: CI flaked on linting initially, re-run looks good. Approving with one suggestion to add a short note in release notes about staging verification.
Ben Carter: Approved — tests look solid and smoke e2e on staging passed.
release_notes: Incident-bot: added automated diagnostics and runbook linking for on-call alerts. Pager messages and alert threads now include a short diagnostics summary and up to three recommended runbook links. Added new SLO-toolkit utilities used by diagnostics. Verified via staging smoke e2e. No breaking changes.
